notes.name: case_narrative
notes.text: M aged 64 yrs adm c arteriosclerotic CVA. He transferred to rehabilitation two mths later where he developed hypostatic pneumonia. In ICU sputum cultured Klebsiella pneumoniae & pt died 2 days after admission to ICU. He also addicted to alcohol for past 20 yrs & on regular medication for IHD for last 10 yrs.
